mapper.insert: insert into pay_order(platform_no, merchant_id, merchant_code, channel_id, out_trade_no, amount, currency, user_id, client_ip, extra, notify_url, request_id, pay_url, upstream_no, mall_order_id, mall_order_no, pay_amount, subsidy, status, notify_status, notify_count, create_time, update_time) values(#{platformNo}, #{merchantId}, #{merchantCode}, #{channelId}, #{outTradeNo}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{userId}, #{clientIp}, #{extra}, #{notifyUrl}, #{requestId}, #{payUrl}, #{upstreamNo}, #{mallOrderId}, #{mallOrderNo}, #{payAmount}, #{subsidy}, #{status}, #{notifyStatus}, #{notifyCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from pay_order where platform_no = #{platformNo} limit 1
select * from pay_order where mall_order_no = #{mallOrderNo} limit 1
select * from pay_order where merchant_code = #{merchantCode} and out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} limit 1
mapper.update: update pay_order set status = 'PAID', pay_time = now(), update_time = now(), upstream_no = #{upstreamNo}, upstream_raw = #{upstreamRaw} where platform_no = #{platformNo} and status <> 'PAID'
update pay_order set notify_status = #{notifyStatus}, notify_count = notify_count + 1, last_notify_time = now(), update_time = now() where platform_no = #{platformNo}
mapper.select: select * from pay_order where status = 'PAID' and notify_status <> 1 and notify_count < 6 and notify_url is not null and notify_url <> '' order by id asc limit #{limit}
